# ISD Info Solutions

> ISD Info Solutions is an enterprise digital growth engineering and technology solutions agency. We engineer high-converting web platforms, omni-channel search and AI discoverability (SEO, AEO, GEO), custom AI platforms, education ecosystem solutions, and Salesforce & Copado DevOps.

- **Website**: https://isdinfosolutions.com

- **Primary Domain**: https://isdinfosolutions.com
- **Executive Email**: info@isdinfosolutions.com

- **Operating Regions**: Global (Offices in India; serving clients across India, North America, UK, UAE, and APAC)
- **Primary Motto**: Build Growth Intelligently. Digital Growth, Engineered.

## Core Engineering Practices

### 1. Digital Growth Engineering™ (DGE)
- **URL**: https://isdinfosolutions.com/services/digital-growth-engineering
- **Focus**: Systematic engineering of digital presence, search discoverability, and compounding pipeline.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Growth Intelligence™ (Market & Search Demand Analysis)
  - Digital Presence Architecture™ (Websites, Knowledge Panels, Brand Directory Systems)
  - Search & AI Visibility™ (SEO, AEO, Generative Engine Optimization [GEO], Entity Optimization)
  - Paid Growth Engineering™ (Google AI Max, Meta Advantage+, Programmatic Media)
  - Content Intelligence & Creation™ (Topic Clusters, AI-Ready Knowledge Assets)
  - Conversion Growth Engineering™ (CRO, Funnel Architecture, High-Velocity A/B Testing)
  - Revenue Intelligence™ (GA4 Server-Side Tracking, Conversions API, Multi-Touch Attribution)
  - Lifecycle Growth Engineering™ (Automated WhatsApp & Email Multi-Channel Nurturing)

### 2. Enterprise Solution Engineering™ (ESE)
- **URL**: https://isdinfosolutions.com/services/enterprise-solutions
- **Focus**: Intelligent digital systems, custom SaaS applications, and workflow automation.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Digital Experience Engineering™ (Portals, Web Apps, Enterprise Design Systems)
  - Application Engineering™ (Custom SaaS Platforms, Modern Internal Tooling)
  - Customer Intelligence & CRM Engineering™ (Salesforce Health Cloud / Sales Cloud, HubSpot, Custom CRM)
  - Salesforce & Copado DevOps™ (CI/CD Pipelines, Sandbox Management, Metadata Migrations)
  - AI Systems Engineering™ (Autonomous AI Agents, Enterprise Copilots, RAG Pipelines)
  - AI Workflow Engineering™ (Multi-Step Intelligent Process Automation)
  - Connected Engagement™ (Unified WhatsApp, RCS, Email, and SMS Infrastructure)

### 3. Education Ecosystem Engineering™ (EEE)
- **URL**: https://isdinfosolutions.com/services/education-ecosystem-engineering
- **Focus**: Strategic institutional transformation, regulatory accreditation, and admissions funnel growth.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Institutional Excellence Engineering™ (Strategic Planning & Governance Frameworks)
  - Regulatory & Accreditation Advisory™ (AICTE, UGC, NAAC, NBA, NIRF Ranking Advisory)
  - Academic Ecosystem Engineering™ (Outcome-Based Education & Board of Studies Support)
  - Industry-Academia Integration™ (Corporate MoUs, Co-Branded Centers of Excellence)
  - Talent-to-Career Engineering™ (Placement Cell Transformation & Employability Analytics)
  - Enrolment Growth Engineering™ (Admissions Funnel Optimization & CRM Lead Nurturing)
  - Education Growth Marketing™ (Institutional Brand Authority & Multi-Channel Campaigns)
